calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, calendar_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_year >= 2024 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date d
WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
   OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
   OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

WITH period2_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
     OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  this_year.fiscal_week,
  this_year.fiscal_week_start_date,
  this_year.fiscal_week_end_date,
  this_year.net_sales as net_sales_this_year,
  last_year.net_sales as net_sales_last_year,
  ROUND((this_year.net_sales - last_year.net_sales) / last_year.net_sales * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM period2_sales this_year
LEFT JOIN period2_sales last_year 
  ON this_year.fiscal_week = last_year.fiscal_week 
  AND this_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND last_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE this_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY this_year.fiscal_week
